production: built-in image_gen creative source + deterministic crop, nearest-neighbor scaling, alpha cleanup, quiet asphalt palette reduction, and tile seam conditioning

master_reference.role: locks the late-1990s 32-bit pixel cluster language, outline, lighting, palette temperature, and detail density; it is not copied into environment art

visual_contract.style: rich late-1990s 32-bit 2D pixel art with crisp stepped contours and deliberate pixel clusters
visual_contract.outline: dark navy outlines, about one authored base pixel on small forms and two to three base pixels on large silhouettes
visual_contract.shading: three to four hard-edged shade levels; warm late-afternoon light from upper right and cool blue-gray shadow masses
palette: warm amber porch and gate accents
visual_contract.material_language: slightly worn, ordinary Korean neighborhood surfaces with restrained texture clusters
forbidden: text, labels, signs with readable copy, logos, watermarks
baked player, pursuers, coins, power-ups, or collision effects
English text on the home gate
fine noise sharper than the student sprite

viewport_contract.background_source_to_world: source pixel * 2 world units; runtime pixels are nearest-neighbor 4x source
viewport_contract.camera: center x at 216 authored-world units; reveal authored overscan through explicit viewport crop and never stretch one axis
background_notes: Distant school, shop, and rooftop skyline should sit around source y=150 (world y=300).
The full top and bottom continue as genuine sky, walls, courtyard, and atmosphere; no flat padding or duplicated edge rows.
The center-bottom road is intentionally quiet because runtime road, rails, and player are separate layers.
The background contains no static road, junction, obstacle, or character silhouette.

layer_stack.name: facade_walls
layer_stack.role: opaque modular side-wall panels placed by runtime
layer_stack.perspective: front-on planar UV panel for 90-degree turns

layer_stack.name: asphalt
layer_stack.collision: visual material only; runtime owns road edge

alley_background.content: quiet warm sky, distant low-rise Korean school/shop/rooftop skyline, lower courtyard and wall atmosphere

source_crop.method: aspect-preserving center crop before nearest-neighbor resize; no axis stretch

asphalt.content: muted blue-gray asphalt with tiny restrained cracks and drain grit

facade_school.content: school-red brick and cream plaster wall with restrained fence or institutional trim

facade_shops.content: closed neighborhood shop frontage with faded teal metal roller shutters and cream trim

facade_homes.content: cream painted residential brick, small doors, utility boxes, and quiet porch detail

facade_construction.content: faded teal corrugated construction hoarding with simple dark supports and cream safety blocks

obstacle_hurdle.content: low broad wooden pallet stack with two tied flat boxes, readable from incoming road view

obstacle_shutter.content: front-facing faded teal roller shutter in a simple metal frame; lowered door leaves a clearly open low gap along the bottom
obstacle_shutter.anchor: bottom contact line; opening stays alpha

obstacle_stack.role: compact occupied-lane hazard for narrow segments
obstacle_stack.content: short broad two-tier carton and crate block, simple readable silhouette, foot contact at bottom

home_gate.content: Korean residential double gate, cream brick pillars, small warm porch roof, simple dark metal gate

preserved_behavior: TempleRun controls, lane/tilt movement, jump, slide, turn timing, score, collision, spawning, duration, and result lifecycle stay unchanged.
Environment art remains decorative or collision-readable only; no new gameplay rules are introduced by home_gate or facades.
Existing assets/images/temple_run files remain untouched and available as the original game family.
qc_requirements: Inspect every raw and processed asset at native size and nearest-neighbor enlarged size.
Confirm no transparent asset has magenta fringe, opaque corner contamination, clipping, or edge contact.
Confirm asphalt opposite edges are deterministic and visually quiet when tiled 3x3.
Confirm facade panels share bottom contact, but remain distinct in silhouette and palette family.
Confirm hurdle, shutter, and stack silhouettes read as jump, slide, and occupied-lane hazards at runtime scale.
Confirm background covers top and bottom authored overscan with genuine continuation art and has no baked road or character.
Run environment viewport rectangle validation and report runtime integration as pending until the runtime worker wires these paths.
